rows.finding: Anonymous callers can certify schedule changes as a head student
Anonymous requests can run the administrator's schedule ingestion job
Docker defaults expose database and cache outside the host
Startup logs reveal database and cache credentials
Unbounded matchmaking lists amplify anonymous requests into database work
